description: Mondello Park motorsport events - Ireland's National Motorsports Campus

date_source.notes: Event dates exist only as visible HTML text on detail pages. No machine-readable date format available. Range format: 'Month DD, YYYY - Month DD, YYYY'. Same-day ranges collapse to one day.

time_source.notes: No event start/end times are machine-readable anywhere in the source. Time fields left empty.

status_source.notes: Reuse Conexão Event Status; do not invent statuses. Status gate via _event_status field in Event Runtime.

ticket_url_source.notes: Capture primary 'Book Now' Ticketsolve URL (strip ?utm_source=… params) as ticket CTA. Store secondary IDs/external links in custom meta, not URL fields.

notes.platform: WordPress (self-hosted, SiteGround edge). Theme mondello-theme. Yoast SEO 28.3.
notes.rest_api: Yes - X-WP-Total: 29; ?per_page=100 returns all 29 events in one JSON request.
notes.public_api_for_event_data: None. /wp-json/wp/v2/events exposes id/slug/title/link/date/modified/event_category-IDs/featured_media/yoast_head but no event date/time/venue/price/ticket.
notes.ticketing_platform: Ticketsolve (JS SPA behind Queue-it + Safetynet). tickets.mondellopark.ie is legacy dead Checkfront subdomain (Cloudflare 403).
notes.structured_data: No schema.org/Event anywhere. Yoast JSON-LD = WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization/ImageObject only (publish timestamps, not event dates).
notes.events_discovered: 29 published (sitemap ∩ REST). 6 upcoming (Sep 12 → Nov 29 2026); 23 past/archived still published.
notes.sample_tested: 17 detail pages parsed end-to-end + listing + REST + Ticketsolve shell.
notes.location_default: Mondello Park, Donore, Naas, Co. Kildare, Eircode: W91 T957; phone +353 (0)45 860200. County=Kildare, town=Naas.
notes.audit_today_reference: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 (from server Date response header)
notes.implementation_approach: JSON-backed importer handler - the Stage B implementation will use a JSON-backed importer handler pattern consistent with existing Conexão importer pipeline. This JSON setup file documents the source configuration; actual implementation must follow from this setup, not precede it.

review_notes.fia-euro-rx: detail URL redirects externally (301 to https://erxmondellopark.com/index.html); Stage B must determine whether canonical event identity can still be established safely.
review_notes.james-deane-130-showdown: ticket destination is external (130showdown.com); do not skip solely because ticketing is external if the Mondello Park event page itself is a valid event source. Import canonical+dates as a free event at admin discretion.

skip_rules.past-dated_events: skip - importer already enforces 'never creates past events'; mandatory because source publishes past events
skip_rules.notes: Keep only genuinely deterministic skip rules. Do not skip events solely because ticketing is external - that decision belongs in Stage B implementation based on actual source evidence.
